messages:
karim: Quick heads-up — automated qbench showed a reproducible drop for int4 on the long-summarization promptset this morning (~5-7 rouge-L). Not a fluke in nightly.

tess: saw that too. clustering shows failures when inputs have nested bullets and code fences.

olga: could be tokenizer-normalization interaction with quant kernels. did we change any curation normalization rules in the last deploy?

karim: only small dedupe tweak last week (strip punctuation on metadata). i'll diff the promptset snapshots.

mike: i'll run a controlled matrix: int8, q4b, q4_0, qint4; same seed, deterministic decode. small eval (100 samples) to see pattern.

tess: splitting samplebank into 16 shards for bisect — initial pass shows shard 11 and 12 have bulk of regressions. preparing snapshot.

ops-bot: label queue "int4-longsumm-audit" created with 150 items. priority: review-format.

olga: recommend we snapshot 200 examples from shards 11-12 into a temporary golden set and do paired human A/B (int8 vs int4). that will tell us whether outputs are objectively worse or just metric-skew.

karim: agreed. mike, can you run paired eval on that snapshot once tess shares it? use --paired --seed 42.

mike: on it. command: ```tools/eval --paired --modelA redwood-stable-int8 --modelB redwood-stable-int4-q4b --prompts snapshot_shard11-12.json --seed 42 --out /tmp/paired.json```

tess: snapshot uploaded to //samplebank/snapshots/1745654321-shard11-12.json and pushed to label queue. labelers assigned for 4 hours tomorrow.

olga: if humans confirm quality drop, next step is to test disabling the punctuation-stripping normalization to see if prompt canonicalization is amplifying quant error.

karim: logging owners: mike (paired runs), tess (snapshot + labeling), olga (curation config tests). pause any int4 rollout until we have paired labels. will update regression ticket.

mike: preliminary paired run done — automated metrics still favor int8; uploading artifacts. humans inbound.

ops-bot: label status update: 34/150 labeled, flags on ~6 items for ambiguous expected-summary due to truncated inputs.

karim: thanks. reconvene after labels complete. short-term mitigation: pin canary to int8 replicas for long-summ route.

olga: noted, i'll open a small PR to revert the punctuation normalization flag behind a runtime toggle for testing.

tess: adding reproduction script to repo: eng-ml/ops/repro-longsumm-int4.sh

karim: perfect. target follow-up in ~12-18h after labels. :thumbsup:
